Stored basis_spread 1225.0 should be normalized from the source basis-point term S + 1225 PIK to 12.25 percent points for the first Integro loan.

rationale: C115 flagged six basis_spread values as outside the expected percentage range. The cited raw SOI rows show the values appear in Interest Term as basis-point spreads (S + 1075, S + 1225, S + 650, S + 775), not whole percent-point basis_spread values. The extraction retained the basis-point numbers directly, so the stored values are scaled 100x too high.
